name: @lancedb/arrow-flight-sql-client
description: A native typescript project for querying Flight SQL endpoints

scripts.generate-protos: cd protos && pbjs -t static-module -w commonjs -o ../src/generated/flight.js Flight.proto && pbts -o ../src/generated/flight.d.ts ../src/generated/flight.js && pbjs -t static-module -w commonjs -r fsql -o ../src/generated/flightsql.js FlightSql.proto && pbts -o ../src/generated/flightsql.d.ts ../src/generated/flightsql.js && pbjs -t static-module -w commonjs -o ../src/generated/any.js any.proto && pbts -o ../src/generated/any.d.ts ../src/generated/any.js

author: Weston Pace
